title: Eclipse
author: Stephenie Meyer
summary: Bella is torn between the vampire she loves and the werewolf who loves her, while a series of killings in Seattle points to a vengeful vampire building an army. The young are forced to ally against it.
readIf: you want the most plot-heavy and angsty chapter of the Twilight saga.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books or are tired of love triangles and intense, slightly controlling romance.

pairings.reason: A later romance that offers a similar rush of forbidden attraction and a dangerous hero, with an adult edge.
A lighter young adult romance with a love triangle at the core and no monsters.
The original brooding literary vampire novel, much more philosophical and melancholy.
